headline: After 1 share of SK Hynix triggers $60 million in forced liquidations, Korea's Nextrade urgently suspends pre-market limit orders
summary: Nextrade will temporarily ban limit orders at the 30% daily price limit during pre-market trading from August 12. The move follows two 'fat finger' flash crashes in SK Hynix shares that triggered about $60 million in forced liquidations.
why: SK Hynix is a major Korean memory chipmaker, and trading rule changes on alternative venues affect how its shares are priced before the main session.

impacts.name: SK Hynix
impacts.why: Pre-market limit-order restrictions target price distortion caused by flash crashes in SK Hynix shares.
